My dear [Mr Macmillan](/person/939),
I send a second instalment of the [Dove in the Eagle’s Nest](/book/62), I suppose about enough for another [number](/periodical/78).
I hope I am to have the proofs, for there is a mention of Maximilian in the first chapter as grown up which I must alter.
I have done two more chapters of [Bethlehem](/topic/177), - that is I have written them, but I am not satisfied with the second of them.
Many thanks for the four copies of [Golden Deeds](/book/51).
What an unusually glorious spring.

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge
